admin.title: Analytics
admin.subtitle: How many people visit your pages — without cookies and without stored visitor data.
admin.intro: We measure with Plausible on our own server: no cookies, no profiles across sites. IP address and browser identification are transmitted to the measurement service, but there they are only processed into a hash that changes daily, to recognise repeat visits, and are not stored — what remains stored is only page, source, country, browser and device type. So you do not need a consent banner for it.
admin.howTo: Create a site there for your address. Plausible then shows you a script id that starts with pa-. Enter it here — that is all it takes, your pages report themselves from the next page view on.
admin.measureHint: We measure with Plausible on our own server: no cookies, no consent banner. IP address and browser identification are transmitted but not stored — what remains stored is only page, source, country, browser and device type. Switching it on is all it takes, your pages report themselves from the next page view on.
admin.measureOn: Your pages are being counted. The numbers appear below.
admin.overrideTitle: Your own Plausible site is set
admin.overrideHint: While a script id is set under „Advanced“, everything is measured into that site — the switch above has no effect on it. Clear the field and save to give it back its effect.
admin.advancedHint: Do you have your own site on our Plausible instance? Enter its script id here. It overrides the switch above: measuring then goes into your site only.
admin.scriptIdHelp: Starts with pa- and is shown in Plausible under „Site Installation“. Leaving the field empty and saving turns measuring off again.
admin.scriptIdHelpShared: Starts with pa- and is shown in Plausible under „Site Installation“. Leaving the field empty and saving gives the switch above its effect back.
admin.previewEmpty: No script — nothing is measured for this community.
admin.previewEmptyShared: No site of your own — the switch above applies.
admin.savedHint: Freshly loaded pages include the script from now on.
admin.savedOffHint: No script is included any more.
admin.saveFailedHint: Please check the script id and try again.
admin.planHint: Analytics is included from Personal onwards. While your plan does not include it, nothing is measured on your pages and the field stays locked.
admin.unavailableTitle: Not set up for this instance
admin.unavailableHint: No Plausible instance is configured. Without one there would be no address to load the script from.
admin.statsHint: The last 30 days. A visit counts once, no matter how many pages it covers.
admin.statsEmptyHint: The first visit counts within a few minutes. Open your page in another browser if you do not want to wait.
admin.statsUnavailableHint: Measuring continues — only the display is stuck. Please try again in a few minutes.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Where your visitors come from, what they read and what they read it with.
stats.planHint: Analytics is included from Personal onwards. While your plan does not include it, nothing is measured on your pages and there is nothing to show here.
stats.inactiveHint: Switch measuring on — your pages report themselves from the next page view on, and the first numbers show up here a few minutes later.
stats.emptyHint: The first visit counts within a few minutes. Open your page in another browser if you do not want to wait.
stats.unavailableHint: Measuring continues — only the display is stuck. Please try again in a few minutes.

validation.scriptIdInvalid: Please enter a valid script id — it starts with pa- and contains only letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
